messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: stripe.webhooks.delivery failure spike > 60% for region us-east-1. paging oncall: @elena (primary oncall), please ack. See /incidents/1923456789
elena: acked. investigating. any customer-visible symptoms reported?
sam: seeing 5xx rejects from our /webhook endpoint starting ~12:37 UTC. Logs show signature verification failures: `signature_mismatch`. first sample:
```
2026-03-15T12:37:11Z ERROR webhook_handler: stripe_signature: 'v1=abcdef', computed='v1=xxxx' status=401 path=/api/webhook/stripe
```

elena: interesting — we rolled out new webhook-parser lib two days ago. Could be change in header handling.
matt: on the billing side customers are reporting invoice delivery delays. Stripe is starting retry/backoff and some accounts moved to quota_enforced state (we're seeing 429s for entitlement checks).
elena: timeline: roll forward 12:00 new parser deployed to webhooks svc; errors spike at 12:37. probable cause: parser strips whitespace differently so signature base string mismatched.
nora: can we flip quick config to accept both signing header formats? If not, fallback to old binary until patch.
elena: patch idea: accept either header key `Stripe-Signature` or `stripe-signature` and trim CRLFs before HMAC. quick hotfix in 5m, deploy to canary.
sam: wearing my backend hat: can we enable a permissive verification mode for 10 minutes to let events through while we deploy fix? risk is replay attacks but window small.
matt: support impact: enabling permissive mode will let more events through — good for billing flows. but note we might need to re-check duplicates for idempotency.
customer-support: field reports: several enterprise customers complained their invoices show "pending" and some have SSO issues — critical customers: AcmeCorp and NovaPay.
elena: action items: 1) deploy parser-fix to canary (sam) 2) enable permissive verification for 10m (elena) 3) notify Stripe account manager and escalate if quota_enforced persists (matt) 4) support comms draft (customer-support + matt)
sam: pushing canary now: `kubectl set image deploy/webhooks webhooks=webhooks:v2026-03-15-1600 --namespace=prod` — logs show canary receiving events and verification passing for recent deliveries.
devops-bot: deploy rollout at 12:47: image webhooks:v2026-03-15-1600 -> 1/1 ready (canary)
elena: enabling permissive mode: toggling `WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_MODE=permissive` via feature flag (FF) — will revert in 10m. Command: `ffctl set webhooks.signature_mode permissive --env=prod`.
devops-bot: feature flag change applied at 12:48 UTC by elena.
sam: canary verification looks good. promoting rollout to 20% now.
elena: monitoring metrics: delivery_success rate increased from 32% -> 88% in canary. starting gradual rollout.
matt: Stripe update: account manager confirmed quota enforcement is automatic when retries/backlog grows. once we clear backlog and deliver events, entitlements should auto-unblock. still keep stripe-engage on standby.
customer-support: crafting outbound note: short apology, ETA to resolution ~15-20m, workaround (no action required if you see pending invoices — they will process once we clear queue). Will send to affected customers after we have stable rollout.
elena: OK rolling to 100% now. sam, please watch for any duplicate processing — we may need to run idempotency reconcile for invoice events.
sam: rollout complete at 12:59 UTC: `kubectl rollout status deploy/webhooks --timeout=5m` -> success.
elena: reverting permissive mode at 13:04 (5m after stable) — `ffctl set webhooks.signature_mode strict --env=prod`.
devops-bot: feature flag reverted at 13:04 UTC by elena.
matt: monitoring: billing entitlement checks success rate back to 99% by 13:10. Stripe shows backlog drained, no longer in quota_enforced for affected accounts.
customer-support: sent outbound to affected customers at 13:12: "We've resolved a transient webhook delivery issue that affected invoice processing. No action required. Contact us if you see unresolved pending items."
elena: brief postmortem notes: root cause: strict header handling in new parser. Contributing factors: insufficient canary traffic and no unit test for varied header casing/whitespace. Mitigations: add unit tests, require 30m canary with traffic replay for webhook path, add dashboard alert for signature_mismatch rate > 5%. Owner: sam for patch/tests; elena for runbook update; matt to confirm billing monitoring wiring.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: primary mitigations applied, monitoring stable. Incident duration: 36 minutes. Refer to /incidents/1923456789/postmortem for writeup. :white_check_mark:
